name: ImgSlider
description: A text header (eyebrow with decoration + accent color, title with <strong> accent, description, optional CTA buttons) above an image/video gallery in one of five Figma layouts: single, grid, thumbs, fullbleed, or edge.
when_to_use: Project showcases, client galleries, or teaser rows where a headline introduces a set of visuals. For a single in-section image next to a paragraph use Section; for a full-bleed opener use Hero.
capabilities: five layout variants: single (1 image + arrows), grid (2 × 2 lead + square tiles, static), thumbs (main + 6-column thumbnail grid), fullbleed (section-wide 21:9), edge (520 × 360 cards past the right edge, dots + counter)
header alignment left/center/right; header link(s) render as text links (Alle anzeigen →)
slides of image, uploaded video, or external video URL, with poster and caption overlay ("index / total · caption")
aspect ratio (auto, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 1:1) for single/thumbs; grid tiles square, fullbleed 21:9, edge 520 × 360
arrows (single/fullbleed centered below, edge in the head), autoplay (6s, pauses on hover), loop, swipe
empty image slides draw a placeholder only in the playground / editor; a live site drops them
gallery variant: paged 4:3 tile grid (12 per page), page numbers, next-page link, address / facts in the head, body_below under the photos; switches show_page_line, show_forward_link

variants.description: One slide per view with a caption overlay and round arrows centered below. Default.
Static gallery: a 2 × 2 lead image plus four square tiles in three columns (first 5 slides). No slider controls.
Main slide with a caption overlay and a 6-column thumbnail grid below; clicking a thumbnail changes the main image.
The 21:9 frame spans the whole section; head and arrows stay in the content width.
520 × 360 cards run past the right edge; arrows sit in the head, progress dots + counter below.

Equal 4:3 tiles, 4 / 3 / 1 per row (desktop / tablet / mobile), 12 per page with page numbers and a next-page link; address and facts under the title, a text below the photos. A project page (pos268).

breakpoints.mobile: ≤640: head stacks; grid becomes 2 columns with a 4:3 lead; edge cards 300, gap 16.
breakpoints.desktop: Head row with the link bottom-right (edge: arrows); content width 1100; edge cards 520.

figma.portReason: Rebuilt on the spec node names (islider-*) with token values; no slider library (fade stage + native scroll-snap track).

islider-caption-text.none: unsure: the design text carries the 'n / total · ' counter ImgSlider computes itself; storing it would draw the counter twice

pager-num.none: computed: the gallery numbers its pages itself

ai.prompt_summary: ImgSlider: header + media gallery. Settings: variant (single|grid|thumbs|fullbleed|edge|gallery, matching Figma), eyebrow, eyebrow_decoration (none|bar|dot), eyebrow_color (7 semantic tokens), title, description, text_align (left|center|right), aspect_ratio (auto|16/9|4/3|21/9|1/1; single/thumbs only), show_arrows, show_thumbnails (thumbs), show_dots / show_counter (edge), autoplay, loop; buttons[] (rendered as text links, typically one 'Alle anzeigen'; not shown on edge). Content in slides[] (min 1): { type (image|video|video_url), image, video, video_url, poster, alt, caption }. Gallery variant (a project page): address, facts (one line), body_below (text under the photos), forward_label (next-page link, default Weiter), show_page_line, show_forward_link; up to 12 photos per page, more pages get page numbers.
ai.content_guidelines: 3-6 slides. Captions one line, rendered as an overlay pill with an index counter. Keep <strong> emphasis to one phrase. Grid uses the first 5 slides (1 lead + 4 tiles).

field_hints.variant: Layout family; single/thumbs/fullbleed/edge are sliders, grid is a static composition.
field_hints.slides.type: Chooses which source field is read: image, video (upload), or video_url.
field_hints.slides.caption: Rendered as an overlay pill prefixed with 'index / total ·'.
field_hints.eyebrow_color: Semantic theme token; also drives the title <strong> accent.
